name: Crowded-short funding squeeze (1h long, RSI-washout confirmation)
rationale: MECHANISM (H3 with an RSI-washout arm replacing the vol ceiling): the cleanest squeeze setups pair a crowded-short funding extreme with a price that is genuinely washed out (RSI oversold), not merely a funding blip in a calm tape — the oversold read confirms the shorts piled in during an actual down-move that is now exhausting. Counterparty: the crowded short forced to cover; edge is the non-economic cover flow ignited by the first bid. Long spot, funding accrues. Entry: funding_rate cross_down through a negative floor AND ret_Nd above a knife-guard (stopped falling) AND rsi below an oversold floor (washout) AND open_interest above a rising floor (shorts adding). DISCONFIRMER: replace the funding cross with a static funding-LEVEL lt — if equal, the event is redundant with decayed carry-harvest; and drop the funding arm entirely keeping only rsi-oversold + ret_Nd-stopped — if that matches, this is generic oversold-bounce and funding adds nothing. Net of ~20bps round-trip.
catalyst: funding cross_down into a crowded short + RSI washout + price basing + OI rising
